project_type: Python stdlib+scientific data pipeline (options GEX indicator engine) with a Tradovate JavaScript renderer as the final artifact
language: Python 3.11 (engine + tests); JavaScript (Tradovate custom indicator, thin renderer)
build_system: no build step; pyenv-managed Python. There is no packaging yet (no pyproject/setup). Modules live under src/gammamap and are imported via a path insert or `PYTHONPATH=src`. Tests are the build gate.
test_framework: pytest (v9.1.1, available via pyenv). No tests exist yet; create tests/ at repo root. Use PYTHONPATH=src so `import gammamap...` resolves.
build_command: export PYENV_ROOT="/root/.pyenv" && export PATH="$PYENV_ROOT/shims:$PYENV_ROOT/bin:$PATH" && pyenv global 3.11.15 && python -c "import gammamap" (with PYTHONPATH=src)
test_command: export PYENV_ROOT="/root/.pyenv" && export PATH="$PYENV_ROOT/shims:$PYENV_ROOT/bin:$PATH" && pyenv global 3.11.15 && PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/ -q
verification_instructions: 1) Ensure pyenv env is exported IN THE SAME bash call (env does not persist across calls; /tmp does not persist across calls). 2) Install deps in the same call: pip install numpy scipy. 3) Run PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/ -q. 4) For the round-trip GEX check, recompute gross GEX from the committed distilled files and compare to a reference. 5) The existing capture snapshot at data/snapshots/2026-09-06/230612Z is the canonical live-format fixture for tests (QQQ spot 717.5, NDX current_price 29544.1543, basis 21.0957, NQ=MNQ=29565.25).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Distilled snapshots under data/snapshots/<date>/<time>/greeks_*.csv.gz + data/snapshots/oi/*.csv.gz + meta.json + index.jsonl ARE committed and are produced by scripts/capture_snapshot.py (already built). Raw chain_*.json.gz are gitignored. New: levels files (JSON) written by the levels writer should be committed for the sample dates; the 628MB Kaggle raw CSV must be gitignored, only distilled per-date levels committed.
setup_instructions: export PYENV_ROOT="/root/.pyenv" && export PATH="$PYENV_ROOT/shims:$PYENV_ROOT/bin:$PATH" && pyenv global 3.11.15 && pip install numpy scipy pytest. numpy 2.4.6 and scipy 1.17.1 install cleanly from PyPI (OPEN_INTERNET). Everything MUST be done inside a single bash invocation because env exports and /tmp do NOT persist between invocations; data written under the repo path DOES persist.
environment_constraints: Network: OPEN_INTERNET (PyPI, CBOE cdn, Yahoo, Kaggle all reachable). CRITICAL sandbox quirk: each bash invocation is a FRESH container -- /tmp is wiped and env exports do not carry over between calls, so combine download+process into one command and re-export pyenv every call. Work on branch nuke_root; do NOT create branches. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator does that). No secrets: CBOE live and Kaggle CC0 need no auth; any future key must come from an env var, never hardcoded.
contribution_requirements: Follow the existing code style in src/gammamap: stdlib-first, dataclasses, extensive WHY-comments citing paper sections and findings corrections (C1-C9), quality flags emitted (never silently fixed). Reuse capture.py/distill.py/sources.py -- do NOT rebuild the capture layer (build-order step 1 is DONE). Commit in logical steps with clear messages on nuke_root. distilled SCHEMA_VERSION is currently 1.1.0.
key_patterns: distill.py already splits NDX (AM-settled) vs NDXP (PM-settled dailies) and keys contracts on (root,expiry,type,strike) -- the mandatory join key (C7). GEX = s*Gamma*OI*M*S^2*0.01 = $ per 1% move. NDX feed gamma is quantized to ~14 values (C8) so NDX gamma MUST be computed from IV via a fitted surface; QQQ raw feed gamma (0.2% of peak) is clean enough for v1. current_price disagrees with parity forward (C9: NDX -46pts) so forward per expiry MUST come from put-call parity, and basis = NQ - (parity-implied index anchor), NOT NQ - current_price. Basis mapping: NDX strike +basis -> NQ -> (1:1) MNQ. Verified reference: NDX 24200/NQ 24242 -> basis +42; zone 24250-24350 NDX -> 24292-24392 NQ.
